# Hi Temp Mail — Full Documentation

> > Hi Temp Mail is a free, privacy-first disposable email web app. It generates a working temporary
> email address instantly (no login, no signup), auto-detects OTP/verification codes as one-tap
> copyable chips, and lets users save mailboxes locally (browser localStorage) and restore them days
> later to keep receiving mail. Receive-only; mailboxes are provisioned by the Mail.tm API via a
> technical relay. No analytics, no ads, no tracking; the app has no server-side database.

This file (llms-full.txt) is the complete documentation of Hi Temp Mail in a single plain-text
markdown document, intended for AI assistants, agents and search crawlers. It contains the full

## About

What the app is, who it is for, how it works, features and technology.
Source: https://hitempmail.app/about.html

## What is Hi Temp Mail?

Hi Temp Mail is a free, privacy-first disposable email service that gives you a working temporary
email address the moment you open the app — no account, no signup, no personal details. Use it to
receive verification emails, one-time passwords (OTPs), download links and newsletters without ever
exposing your real inbox.

## Who is it for?

Anyone who needs a quick email address for a low-risk signup: free trials, public Wi-Fi portals,
forum accounts, one-time downloads, app testing, or simply receiving a verification code without
sharing your primary email. If you would not write your real address on a sticky note in a café, use
a temporary one.

## How it works

1. Open the app — a secure mailbox is generated instantly.
2. Copy the address and paste it into any signup or verification form.
3. Watch the inbox — verification codes are detected automatically and shown as a one-tap copy chip.

## Feature highlights

- Instant mailbox generation — an address is ready in seconds
- 10-minute mailbox lifetime with a one-tap Extend button
- Saved Mailboxes — bookmark a mailbox and restore it days later; OTPs keep arriving
- OTP auto-detection with auto-copy option
- Attachments — view and download files from emails
- Privacy blur, remote-image blocking and sanitized email HTML
- Light & dark themes, pull-to-refresh, offline-friendly local storage
- Export / import backups of saved mailboxes
- No ads, no analytics, no tracking

## Technology

Hi Temp Mail is a single-page web app that talks to the Mail.tm REST API through a lightweight
technical relay (Mail.tm's API does not allow direct browser access from third-party sites). Your
mailbox credentials live only in your browser's local storage. Hi Temp Mail is an independent project
and is not affiliated with Mail.tm.

## Status

Version 5.0 · Free forever · Private by design.

## FAQ

Ten answers on mailbox lifetime, OTP detection, saved mailboxes, privacy and safety.
Source: https://hitempmail.app/faq.html

## Q1: What is a temporary email address?

A temporary (or disposable) email address is a real, working inbox that you use instead of your
personal email when signing up somewhere. It receives mail exactly like a normal address, but it is
not connected to your identity, so spam and data leaks never reach your real inbox.

## Q2: How long does a mailbox last?

By default a mailbox lives for 10 minutes, and you can extend the timer with one tap. If you save a
mailbox to your Saved Mailboxes vault, you can restore it any time — the same day or days later —
and keep receiving mail, including verification codes.

## Q3: Can I receive OTP and verification codes?

Yes. Hi Temp Mail automatically detects 4–8 digit codes in incoming mail and shows them as a
highlighted chip in the inbox list and a large copy button in the message view. There is also an
optional setting that copies the code to your clipboard the instant it arrives.

## Q4: What does saving a mailbox do?

Saving stores the mailbox address and its password in your browser's local storage — nothing is sent
to any server of ours. You can then reopen that exact mailbox later from the Saved tab and continue
receiving mail addressed to it.

## Q5: Do you read or store my emails?

No. The app runs entirely in your browser and has no server database. Messages are created and
stored by the Mail.tm service when the app requests them on your behalf. There are no analytics
scripts, no advertising and no tracking of any kind.

## Q6: Is Hi Temp Mail free?

Yes — every feature is free, and there is no account, subscription or ad in the app.

## Q7: Can I send email or attachments?

Hi Temp Mail is receive-only. You can view and download attachments that arrive in your mailbox, but
sending email is not supported — which also means the app cannot be used for outbound spam.

## Q8: Why did my email stop working?

Unsaved temporary mailboxes are discarded when you delete them or when the provider expires them. If
a saved mailbox stops working, it was most likely removed on the provider side after prolonged
inactivity; generate a fresh one or remove it from your saved list.

## Q9: Is it safe to use for banking or important accounts?

No. Disposable addresses are for low-risk signups only — trials, downloads, forums, Wi-Fi portals.
Never use one for banking, government, healthcare, work or any account whose loss would hurt you,
because anyone with access to the mailbox could receive its password resets.

## Q10: How do I delete everything?

Use Delete Mail in the app to remove the current mailbox from the provider, Clear all in Settings →
Data to empty your saved vault, and clear your browser's site data to wipe every local trace. That
is everything — there is nothing stored anywhere else.

## Privacy Policy

What is (and is not) collected; localStorage keys; Mail.tm third-party storage; tracking-pixel
blocking. Last updated: 2025.
Source: https://hitempmail.app/privacy.html

## Overview

Hi Temp Mail is private by architecture, not just by policy. The app has no user accounts, no
server-side database of its own, no analytics and no advertising. This page explains exactly what
data exists and where.

## What we never collect

- Your real email address or identity
- Analytics, advertising IDs, fingerprints or tracking pixels
- Cookies used for tracking (the app sets none)
- Server-side logs of your mailbox contents (we keep none)

## Data stored on your device

The app stores its data in your browser's local storage. It never leaves your device, because we
operate no server that could receive it:

- `theme` — your light/dark preference
- - `ar_saved_mails` — mailboxes you bookmarked: address, its Mail.tm password and timestamps, so
  they can be restored later
- - `ar_active_session` — the current mailbox session, so reloading keeps the same address (can be
  turned off in Settings)
- - `ar_settings` — your in-app preferences (auto-refresh interval, sound, vibration, auto-copy OTP,
  privacy blur)
- `read` / `hidden` message ids — so unread badges stay accurate

## How to erase everything

Use Delete Mail for the current mailbox, Clear all (Settings → Data) for saved mailboxes, and your
browser's 'clear site data' for a full wipe. After that, no record of your mailboxes exists anywhere
except on the provider's servers until they expire the account.

## Third-party mail storage (Mail.tm)

Temporary mailboxes and their messages are created and stored by the Mail.tm service (api.mail.tm)
under Mail.tm's own terms and privacy policy — please review them on mail.tm. When you generate a
mailbox, the app registers an account there using a random address and a random password. Because
Mail.tm's API does not allow direct browser calls from third-party sites, your requests are
transparently proxied through a technical relay on this site. The relay forwards your requests and
responses as-is and stores nothing.

## Emails and tracking pixels

Remote images inside emails are blocked by default, so senders cannot log your IP address through
tracking pixels; you can load images for a specific message when you choose to. Email HTML is always
sanitized before display: scripts, frames, forms and event handlers are removed, and links open with
rel='noopener noreferrer' and a no-referrer policy.

## Security

Mailbox passwords are generated with the browser's cryptographic random generator and stored only on
your device. Access tokens are kept in memory, not written to storage, unless you enable Remember
session, which stores the minimum needed to restore your own mailbox on reload. Email content is
rendered through a strict sanitizer.

## Children

Hi Temp Mail is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect any personal
information from anyone — there is simply nothing to collect.

## Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the updated version will always be published on this page. Material changes
will be summarized at the top.

## Disclaimer

As-is service, no affiliation with Mail.tm, not for sensitive accounts, lawful use only.
Source: https://hitempmail.app/disclaimer.html

## General — provided as is

Hi Temp Mail is provided free of charge, 'as is' and 'as available', without warranties of any kind,
express or implied — including but not limited to fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy and
availability. Use it at your own risk.

## Not affiliated with Mail.tm

Hi Temp Mail is an independent tool that uses the public Mail.tm API through a technical relay.
Mail.tm is a service of its respective owner, and mailbox availability, retention and deliverability
depend entirely on that third party. We cannot guarantee that any particular mailbox or message will
work at any time.

## Not for sensitive accounts

Never use disposable email addresses for banking, government, healthcare, employment, cryptocurrency
exchanges or any account whose loss or compromise would cause you harm. Anyone who gains access to
the temporary mailbox could read its password-reset emails. Use disposable addresses only for
low-risk, non-critical signups.

## Lawful use only

You may use Hi Temp Mail only in compliance with all applicable laws and with the terms of service of
any site you use it on. You are solely responsible for your use — the app must not be used for
fraud, harassment, evading bans or any unlawful activity. The app is receive-only and cannot send
email.

## Availability and data loss

Mailboxes may expire, be rate-limited or become unreachable without notice, and messages may fail to
arrive. Do not rely on Hi Temp Mail for anything important, and never save anything valuable in a
temporary inbox. We are not responsible for lost codes, lost accounts or missed emails.

## Limitation of liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Hi Temp Mail authors shall not be liable for any direct,
indirect, incidental, consequential or punitive damages — including lost data, lost accounts or lost
profits — arising from or related to your use of, or inability to use, the app.

## Changes

This disclaimer may be updated from time to time; the current version is always the one published on
this page.

## Feature reference

Complete list of user-facing features in the current version (v5.0):

- **Instant mailbox generation** — a working address is ready the moment the app opens.
- - **10-minute timer + Extend** — mailbox lifetime with one-tap extension and a visual countdown
  ring.
- - **Saved Mailboxes vault** — bookmark any mailbox; restore it later via re-authentication with
  the stored password.
- - **Session restore** — reloading the page keeps the same address while "Remember session" is
  enabled.
- - **OTP auto-detection + auto-copy** — 4–8 digit verification codes are extracted from incoming
  mail and shown as one-tap copy chips; an optional setting copies the code to the clipboard the
  instant it arrives.
- **Inbox search** — filter messages by sender, subject, preview text or the detected OTP code.
- **Attachments view + download** — file chips with type-aware icons and authenticated download.
- - **Privacy blur** — optional blur of sender, subject, preview and addresses, with an eye-toggle
  reveal.
- - **Remote-image blocking** — tracking pixels are blocked by default; images load per message on
  request.
- - **Sanitized HTML rendering** — scripts, frames, forms and event handlers are stripped from email
  bodies; links are no-referrer.
- **Sound / vibration notifications** — WebAudio chime and haptic feedback on new mail.
- **Pull-to-refresh** — gesture refresh on the inbox screen.
- - **Export / import backups** — copy a JSON backup of saved mailboxes to the clipboard and
  re-import it later.
- **Light / dark theme** — persisted preference, applied before first paint to avoid flashing.
- **Web manifest / PWA metadata** — installable app metadata served from /manifest.webmanifest.

## Storage keys

All persistent data lives in the browser's localStorage on the user's device. There is no
server-side database.

| Key | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `theme` | Light/dark theme preference ("dark" or "light"). |
| `ar_saved_mails` | Bookmarked mailboxes: address, Mail.tm password, savedAt and lastUsedAt timestamps. |
| `ar_active_session` | The current mailbox session (address + credentials) so a page reload restores the same address; can be disabled via the "Remember session" setting. |
| `ar_settings` | In-app preferences: auto-refresh interval, sound, vibration, auto-copy OTP, privacy blur, remember session. |

## Contact

Support is self-serve: there is no support email, ticket system or account service, because the app
stores nothing about its users. For answers about mailbox lifetime, OTP codes, saved mailboxes,
privacy and safety, see the FAQ at https://hitempmail.app/faq.html. Agent indexes:
https://hitempmail.app/llms.txt (short) and https://hitempmail.app/llms-full.txt (this file).
